touches.text: A device talks to other devices only over the bus, never by importing them.
The bus handles two kinds of requests:
The messages are stored in a SMALL buffer in memory. The bus keeps no database. A shim that needs to hold mail puts it in the transient tree (see Graph trees).
Every device has a shim. Each shim is its own process, one per instance, and connects to the bus as a client (agreed 2026-10-26).
It answers what it can itself; when it can't (eg a health question it holds no answer to), it wakes the device and asks.
Processes all messages from the bus for its device.
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
base shim: the base class for every shim, customized for the device it interfaces with, internal or external.
